_comment: PLACEHOLDER, not yet run: written on a machine with no GPU access (see project plan Phase 1). Use on the B200/CUDA machine with `python main.py --config configs/gpu_run.json --model yolo26n.pt --pose-model yolo26n-pose.pt`. Re-check that yolo26n.pt/yolo26n-pose.pt and configs/trackers/botsort_reid.yaml are still the current Ultralytics recommendation before trusting this without re-verifying (Ultralytics ships new model generations quickly).

state_machine._comment: Every threshold above was calibrated against the CPU/ByteTrack/YOLOv8n stack (config.json). Swapping to botsort_reid.yaml + a different detector changes track continuity and box geometry enough that these will very likely need real-footage re-calibration -- do not cite results from this config in the paper until they've been re-verified the same way every other fix in this project was (real clip, not just unit tests).
